name: Aaron Ford
office: Attorney General of Nevada (2026 Democratic nominee for governor)
stance: Backs federal frontier-AI safety regulation that preserves state authority; at home stresses guardrails on AI harms to children.

statements.text: Signed the 26-AG letter urging Congress to immediately establish comprehensive federal regulation and safety protocols for frontier AI, including mandatory federal oversight of safety testing, and to prohibit preemption of state law.
We have to advocate that, but we have to do so in a way that is responsible, that protects the public.
Joined a 36-AG letter to Congress opposing federal legislation that would bar states from enacting or enforcing AI laws.
